correctness.rationale: PASS: For a uniformly drawn size-m subset without replacement, conditioning on species i absence yields Cov(I_i,T_m)=a_i(t_i-μ)/N · C(N-a_i-1,m-1)/C(N-1,m-1); summing gives the exact identity. Grouping decreasing abundance levels and using Σ b_j=0 gives a summation-by-parts decomposition -Σ_{j<r}B_j Σ_{h=n_j}^{n_{j+1}-1} C(h,m-2). Pascal binomial coefficients form a totally nonnegative path matrix, and aggregation into ordered disjoint consecutive column blocks preserves total nonnegativity via Cauchy–Binet; variation diminution gives <=var(B_1,...,B_(r-1))<=r-2 sign switches with zeros omitted. For arbitrary r, the binomial polynomials evaluated at distinct nodes N-i-1 form an invertible Newton-Vandermonde matrix; specifying alternations (-1)^m for m=2..r and zero for m=1 yields traits c+b_i/i made positive by large c. This supplies sharp r-2 reversals, not an extrapolation from finite testing. For r=1 all covariances zero; monotone abundance/trait corollary follows from the weighted two-sample rearrangement sign. Independent exact Fraction calculation on N=10, a=(1,2,3,4), t=(56,1/2,181/3,28) gives sample-depth covariances 1/90, -1/360, 1/840.

value.rationale: PASS: The exact richness/abundance-weighted-trait covariance as sampling effort varies is an ecologically meaningful invariant. A sharp universal sign-variation budget controlled by the number of abundance levels, plus a finer cumulative-imbalance criterion and constructive sharpness for all r, clarifies when sampling effort can reverse an association; this is not merely a generic Pascal-matrix theorem restated.
